stayType: Self check-in rooms-only guesthouse plus apartment
accommodation: En-suite rooms at The Nook, some with sea views (number not stated), plus Little Nook, a two-bedroom apartment sleeping up to four
suitableFor: Couples and independent travellers; small families or friends in Little Nook
parking: Available on a first-come, first-served basis (Visit St Ives says it can be pre-booked)
beachAccess: Close to Porthmeor Beach and a short walk to the town and beaches (no distance given)
confirmedFeatures: Free Wi-Fi, self check-in, communal kitchen, lounge, garden/decking area
overview: The Nook is a room-only guesthouse in the Ayr area of St Ives, close to Porthmeor Beach and a short walk from the town. Guests check themselves in and share a kitchen, lounge and sunny garden. Alongside it, Little Nook is a two-bedroom self-catering apartment sleeping four, with its own kitchen and lounge.
surfTripFit: Being near Porthmeor, St Ives' main surf beach, makes it a practical simple base for surfers happy to self-cater.
gaps: Room count, dog policy and board/wetsuit storage not stated.
